panel.runtime.idle: No Pi runtime yet — it starts automatically when you send a message
panel.temporary.note: Temporary sessions are not written to SOXU session history and never appear in the sidebar; Pi still manages the session file under its own rules. Only an explicit "Promote to regular session" registers it in history — if that fails the temporary session is kept and the reason is shown.
panel.promote.hint.runtime: Stop the Pi runtime before promoting: the running process still holds the session file
panel.promote.hint.busy: This turn has not finished yet; promoting waits until it ends
panel.promote.hint.ready: Write this temporary session into persisted history
panel.empty.title: This session has no messages yet
panel.empty.hint: After the first message, Pi writes the session JSONL and SOXU only indexes and displays it read-only.
panel.empty.bridge: This is the browser preview without the local runtime, so real session content cannot be read or sent.
list.evicted.memory: The earliest {count} messages were released from memory; Pi's session file is untouched
list.evicted.live: The earliest {count} live messages were released from the memory window; reload history to see them again
list.log.label: Session messages
list.partial: Preview only — the full text is not loaded
list.truncated: The message exceeds the per-item limit and was truncated
actions.copy.label: Copy message
actions.retry.hint: Coming soon: regenerate from this message
actions.retry.label: Retry (coming soon)
actions.rewind.hint: Coming soon: rewind the session to just before this message
actions.rewind.label: Rewind to here (coming soon)
tabs.list.label: Open sessions
